definition: The SQL subset ECDEV issues, its storage classes and affinity rules, the SQLite date, JSON and core functions it calls, transactions with the three BEGIN behaviours, and a crash-safe multi-process write-ahead log are native, proven against 72000 application statements, 3000000 date and time calls and 338 json_extract cases frozen from SQLite 3.46.0 (rusqlite 0.32.1) and against kill-the-writer durability tests; every other capability is justified not adopted with its knowledge resolved. rusqlite and its 11 transitive packages are gone from Cargo.lock, and the bundled C amalgamation is gone from the build.
